Finance service provider contracts (9 of 9) read against 16 CFR 314.4(f)(2), including the draft security schedule to the intercompany services agreement. Plan business associates (3 of 3): BAAs on file for the TPA and the PBM, with the required terms and 60 days for breach notice; none for the benefits consultant

title: Counsel memo on financial institution status
source_system: Outside counsel memo
what_it_shows: Counsel confirms that Supply (trade credit to businesses only), Home Services (passes along Finance's application link without taking, evaluating or brokering applications) and Fabrication are not financial institutions under 16 CFR 314.2(h)

title: Signed bank partner participation agreement
source_system: General Counsel's files
what_it_shows: Forward-flow participation agreement signed 2026-08-15: from 2027-01 the bank buys participations in new Finance loans and Finance services them; it requires a SOC 2 Type 2 report covering Finance's servicing and the shared platform, a separate SOC 1 Type 2 report on servicing, and notice within 72 hours of determining a security incident affecting servicing systems or participated-loan data

title: 2026 cyber strategy memo and draft forum charter
source_system: vCISO files
what_it_shows: The 2026 cyber strategy ties security priorities to the sponsor's value creation plan (payment integrity, acquisitions, Finance growth with the bank partner), records risk objectives set by the CFO and the vCISO, and was adjusted for the acquisition and AI; a draft charter for a monthly cyber risk forum with the subsidiary Presidents

title: Data loss prevention test
source_system: Labeled HR and Finance test files sent from the suite to an outside address; data room sharing settings
what_it_shows: Labeled HR and Finance test files sent by email to an outside address were delivered; data room sharing required the data owner's approval

title: AI-001 tests: data access, accuracy and prompt injection
source_system: 5 test accounts (one per company) with 12 standard queries each; 50 outputs checked against sources; 5 test emails with hidden instructions
what_it_shows: Supply and Home Services test accounts retrieved a high-cost claimant report from the HR site and vendor bank-detail forms from the accounting site; no Finance loan files were returned; 4 of 50 outputs (8%) had material errors, including a wrong payoff amount in a Finance draft; 1 of 5 summaries repeated a planted link as a recommended action

title: AI-002 tests: adverse action reasons, age bands and validation
source_system: 40 automated declines from 2026-07 and 2026-08; auto-decline rates by age band; vendor responses; cutoff approval records
collected_by: Finance Compliance Officer and Security Manager
what_it_shows: 17 of 40 notices gave only 'credit score below our cutoff' as the reason; the auto-decline rate for applicants 62 or older is 1.4 times the rate for applicants under 62; the vendor confirmed age is an input and has not shown how it is weighted; no validation on Finance's portfolio exists; the cutoffs were set in 2025-10 with no written approval

title: AI-003 selection-rate analysis
source_system: Recruiting software exports; voluntary EEO self-identification kept separate from the tool, 2026-01 to 2026-07
collected_by: VP of Human Resources and Security Manager
what_it_shows: About 6,500 applicants in 2026; technician roles: women passed the threshold at 0.76 of the men's rate; warehouse roles: all groups at or above four-fifths of the highest rate; the vendor provides a score only, and time out of work and distance from site appear to drive scores

title: AI-005 scripted test calls
source_system: 30 scripted calls (10 gas smell, 10 no cooling with a vulnerable person, 10 routine) and 10 Spanish repeats
collected_by: Home Services President and Security Manager
what_it_shows: 18 of 20 emergency calls transferred live with correct safety instructions; one gas-smell caller was offered a next-day appointment and one no-cooling call for an 80-year-old was queued; 4 of 10 Spanish calls were misrouted, 2 of them emergencies; recording and automated-agent disclosures were given in 30 of 30 calls

title: AI-004 and AI-006 approval samples
source_system: 20 coded invoices (ERP) and 20 purchase orders (distribution system)
what_it_shows: Human approval recorded for 20 of 20 invoices and 20 of 20 purchase orders

title: Control assessment: account management
source_system: Identity provider, directory, and SaaS user exports; POL-02; HRIS termination and transfer reports; samples: 25 of 142 terminations, 25 of 58 transfers, 25 new accounts; Branch 2 counter walkthrough
what_it_shows: Terminations (25 of the 142 in EV-005): 7 disabled after the last working day (average 2 business days), 2 of the 7 still active in subsidiary SaaS. Transfers (25 of 58): 6 kept access from the prior role. New accounts (25 of the 166 in EV-001): all approved. Subsidiary managers notify shared IT by email. Review records exist for the ERP only (2026-01, 2026-07). Branch 2 uses 3 shared counter accounts whose passwords have not changed since 2024

title: Control assessment: least privilege
source_system: Directory group export; identity provider role export; collaboration site permission report (96 sites); servicing system role report
what_it_shows: 14 Domain Admins members (4 of them service accounts); 6 standing global administrators; the HR site with plan PHI open to 11 HR staff; 19 Finance users with servicing export rights

title: Control assessment: privileged accounts
source_system: Directory and identity provider privileged role exports; access broker configuration
what_it_shows: Service accounts hold Domain Admins rights; directory, ERP and treasury administration is standing; only cloud console roles are brokered

title: Control assessment: remote access
source_system: VPN configuration; remote access standard; remote access inventory; plant walkthrough
what_it_shows: Usage restrictions, connection requirements and guidance are documented for VPN access; the machine vendors' always-on remote access tool at the plant and the seller's IT provider connection to Home Services North have no authorization record

title: Control assessment: literacy training
source_system: Training platform report (2025); phishing simulation results (2026 Q1-Q2); training content; interviews with 15 staff at 6 sites
what_it_shows: Annual training reached 96% of staff with email accounts; 9 of 15 interviewed warehouse, plant and technician staff had no 2025 training; no training accompanied the AI assistant rollout to 180 users in 2026-05; content was not updated after the 2026 business email compromise attempts or the AI rollout

title: Control assessment: event logging
source_system: SIEM source list; logging configuration exports; draft STD-02
what_it_shows: Event types defined for identity, suite, EDR, firewall, directory and cloud sources; no events forwarded from the ERP, HRIS, loan servicing, distribution and field-service systems, HQ file servers, the plant or Home Services North; event selection not coordinated with Finance or the plan; no written rationale; event types not reviewed since the 2025 MSSP onboarding

title: Control assessment: audit record review
source_system: MSSP monthly reports; weekly privileged review tickets (8 sampled); SIEM use cases
what_it_shows: MSSP monthly reports and 8 sampled weekly privileged review tickets show review and reporting; no review covers loan servicing exports or access to the benefits site

title: Control assessment: audit record retention
source_system: SIEM contract; log archive retention policy; sample of 5 log queries 11 months old
what_it_shows: All 5 queries for 11-month-old records returned results; 1 year searchable in the SIEM and 3 years in the archive

title: Control assessment: continuous monitoring
source_system: Monitoring documents; scan schedule; audit committee report 2026-09
what_it_shows: The continuous monitoring strategy is a draft and monitoring runs by tool; no system-level metrics beyond the phishing click rate; no frequency set for assessing control effectiveness between annual assessments; privacy status not reported; correlation, response and security status reporting are in place

title: Control assessment: baseline configuration
source_system: Cloud image repository; laptop image documentation; server inventory
what_it_shows: Baselines documented and under configuration control for cloud images and the laptop image; none for servers, network devices, plant systems or SaaS tenants; no review schedule or review triggers

title: Control assessment: configuration change control
source_system: Change tickets; sample of 25 of 214 changes to Tier 1 systems (2026-01 to 2026-06)
what_it_shows: 7 of 25 sampled changes (directory, ERP configuration, integration mappings; 3 of them integration service changes) had no peer review, approval or recorded decision; no after-the-fact review of change activity; no change advisory meeting

title: Control assessment: configuration settings
source_system: Benchmark configuration scans of 10 of 46 servers; cloud posture report
what_it_shows: 4 of 10 sampled servers had legacy file-sharing and authentication protocols enabled; no documented settings for servers or network devices; cloud configuration changes monitored and controlled by guardrails

title: Control assessment: system component inventory
source_system: Inventory exports; reconciliation of network scan, EDR, device management, and scanner server lists; plant walkthrough
what_it_shows: The inventory omits the 120 warehouse scanners, network gear at 6 sites, plant floor devices and Home Services North; no duplicate entries; no scheduled review

title: Control assessment: contingency plan
source_system: Cloud recovery plan (2025); BIA (P05); contact list; interviews with the VP of Information Technology and 4 subsidiary Presidents
what_it_shows: The 2025 cloud recovery plan covers cloud workloads only and was never formally approved; no contingency roles outside the cloud team; no recovery metrics; subsidiary workarounds and full restoration of the directory and on-premises servers are not addressed; not distributed to subsidiary Presidents or key vendors; not coordinated with incident handling; not updated for the acquisition; no review frequency

title: Control assessment: contingency plan testing
source_system: Restore test report 2026-03; restore of one HQ file share folder attempted 2026-08-26
what_it_shows: Cloud workloads tested 2026-03, with results reviewed and actions taken; the directory, HQ servers and plant server have never been tested; the HQ folder restore took 9 hours because the NAS index was corrupted

title: Control assessment: system backup
source_system: Backup job reports: 31 of 31 days in July 2026 (cloud), 31 of 31 (suite), 31 of 31 (HQ NAS); plant backup log; backup account configuration
what_it_shows: 31 of 31 July 2026 backup days completed for the cloud, the suite and the HQ NAS; cloud backups are encrypted, write-once and in a separate account; the plant server is backed up weekly to a removable drive, with 2 of the last 8 weekly backups skipped; HQ backups sit on a NAS in the same server room and directory domain as the servers

title: Control assessment: recovery and reconstitution
source_system: Recovery runbooks; interviews
what_it_shows: Recovery runbooks exist for the cloud workloads; no tested procedure recovers or reconstitutes the directory forest, the on-premises servers or the plant server within the BIA RTOs

title: Control assessment: identification and authentication
source_system: Identity provider export; Branch 2 counter walkthrough; SaaS user lists
what_it_shows: Integrated users have unique accounts tied to individuals; Branch 2 uses 3 shared counter accounts

title: Control assessment: MFA for privileged accounts
source_system: Sign-in tests on 25 of 41 privileged accounts; domain controller sign-in policy
what_it_shows: All 16 sampled identity provider and cloud administrators were challenged for MFA; the 9 sampled directory administrators signed in to domain controllers with a password only

title: Control assessment: authenticator management
source_system: Password policy; service account report (61 accounts); IT runbook site permissions; network device check (12 devices)
what_it_shows: Password policy settings confirmed; default passwords changed on the 12 network devices checked; 23 service accounts have non-expiring passwords; the ACH signing service account password is written in an IT runbook readable by 14 IT staff and unchanged since 2021 (reported to the Security Manager and the CFO on 2026-08-26); the Branch 2 shared counter passwords are not changed when staff leave

title: Control assessment: incident handling
source_system: 2024 incident plan; draft P08 runbooks; incident log (10 of 41 incidents sampled); MSSP contract
what_it_shows: The 10 sampled incidents (of the 41 in EV-031) show preparation, detection, containment and eradication; recovery for on-premises systems depends on untested procedures; lessons recorded for 3 of the 10 were not implemented; Home Services North incidents are handled by the seller's IT provider outside the group process; subsidiary incidents are not always logged

title: Control assessment: incident reporting
source_system: POL-03; interviews with 15 staff at 6 sites; MSSP escalation records
what_it_shows: 10 of 15 interviewed staff could not name the incident reporting channel; MSSP escalation records show incident information reaching the Security Manager

title: Control assessment: incident response plan
source_system: 2024 incident response plan; draft P08 runbooks; distribution records
what_it_shows: The 2024 plan sets a roadmap, structure, approach, reportable incidents, resources and responsibilities and is protected from change; it has no subsidiary roles, Finance FTC notice or plan breach steps, no metrics and no sharing with lenders, the bank partner or the sponsor; it was not distributed to the subsidiary Presidents, the MSSP or key vendors and not updated after the acquisition or the 2025 MSSP onboarding; the draft P08 runbooks were reviewed for design

title: Control assessment: nonlocal maintenance
source_system: Plant walkthrough 2026-08-25; remote tool configuration; vendor interviews (2 machine vendors)
what_it_shows: Machine vendor sessions are not approved per session, monitored or recorded; the always-on tool uses a shared password with no MFA; sessions and network connections stay open after maintenance; the tool was not in a security plan before this SSP

title: Control assessment: media sanitization
source_system: Destruction certificates; sample of 10 retired devices (2026 H1)
what_it_shows: 8 of 10 sampled retired devices (of the 64 in EV-036) had destruction certificates; the 2 without, both shipped from subsidiary sites, had none

title: Control assessment: risk management strategy
source_system: 2026 cyber strategy; risk appetite (board approval 2026-09-22 draft reviewed); interviews with 4 subsidiary Presidents
what_it_shows: A 2026 cyber strategy and a draft risk appetite exist and are reviewed yearly; no strategy addresses privacy risk to consumers and plan members; subsidiaries bought AI tools and software outside the strategy, and the Presidents have no written cyber duties

title: Control assessment: personnel termination
source_system: HRIS terminations; sample of 25 of 142 terminations; badge and token return records
what_it_shows: 7 of 25 sampled terminations disabled after the last working day; 2 of the 7 still had active subsidiary SaaS accounts; exit steps, badge and token return and access to records confirmed for the sample

title: Control assessment: risk assessment
source_system: P01 risk register and report; BIA (P05); approval records
what_it_shows: The 2026 group risk assessment uses the SP 800-30 method with scripted ratings and covers Finance customer information and plan ePHI; annual assessments in 2025 and 2026; results documented, reviewed and shared

title: Control assessment: vulnerability monitoring
source_system: Scan reports (2026 Q1-Q2); 50 of 50 critical findings tracked; scanner configuration
what_it_shows: Branches, shops and the plant are not scanned; 9 of 50 critical findings (18%) were remediated after the 30-day target; scan results are analyzed and shared, and scanner checks update automatically

title: Control assessment: external system services
source_system: Vendor register; contracts of 22 critical vendors; SOC 2 review files (8)
what_it_shows: No record that 14 of the 22 critical vendors meet group security requirements, and oversight of those 14 is not defined; the machine vendors have no requirements; the benefits consultant receives plan PHI with no BAA or privacy terms; no monitoring of vendor controls between renewals

title: Control assessment: boundary protection
source_system: Firewall rule exports (cloud hub and 9 sites); reachability test from the plant office network to 2 machine controllers
what_it_shows: External interfaces are monitored and controlled, connections go through managed interfaces, and public components are separated; a plant office laptop reached both machine controllers and the plant server directly; traffic between the plant office and the plant floor is not monitored

title: Control assessment: protection of information at rest
source_system: Encryption report; HQ file server and NAS configuration
what_it_shows: HQ file servers and the HQ NAS are not encrypted at rest; one share holds Finance customer information exports

title: Control assessment: flaw remediation
source_system: Patch reports; firewall firmware versions (9 sites); 50 critical findings
what_it_shows: Flaws are identified, reported and tested before installation; 9 of 50 critical findings were corrected after 30 days; firewall firmware at 2 Home Services shops is one major version behind

title: Control assessment: malicious code protection
source_system: EDR coverage report; EICAR test files on 5 endpoints; scanner and plant device review
what_it_shows: EDR detected and quarantined all 5 test files within 5 minutes; warehouse scanners and plant machine controllers have no malicious code protection

title: Control assessment: system monitoring
source_system: MSSP reports; simulated impossible-travel sign-in on 2026-08-27; SIEM use cases; legal memo on monitoring (2025)
what_it_shows: The MSSP called the Security Manager 18 minutes after the simulated alert; plant floor and Home Services North network connections and machine vendor remote connections are not monitored; no use case identifies bulk exports from the loan servicing system or the warehouse; the 2025 legal memo on monitoring is on file

title: Control assessment: supplier assessments and reviews
source_system: Vendor register; P09 review files
what_it_shows: Supply chain risks were assessed for 8 of the 22 critical vendors; the voice agent and recruiting software vendors were never assessed
